subject: Scaling pathway: technical preview & topology deep-dive
messages:
From: Liam Price <liam.price@scaleworks.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Ochoa <marta@scaleworks.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Scaling pathway: technical preview & topology deep-dive

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the discovery session this morning — appreciate the team walking through Redwood's serving model. ScaleWorks is ready to move from discovery to a focused technical preview to validate throughput and failover behavior before we commit to a Dedicated pool.

We'd like a 60–90 minute deep-dive that covers:
- baseline throughput expectations and batching behavior
- KV-cache/prefix caching (how warm caching works across sessions)
- multi-region failover and cold-start impact on latency
- topology recommendations for our multi-tenant workloads

Top windows that work for our engineering team (all PT):
- Tuesday, Jul 26: 09:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:30
- Thursday, Jul 28: 09:00–11:00

Ben and I would like Redwood engineers present (runtime engineer + solutions lead). Also attaching our discovery notes for context. Could you propose who from Redwood will join and confirm a slot?

Attachments: scaleworks-discovery-notes.pdf (3 pages)

Thanks,
Liam
Liam Price
Director, Platform Engineering
ScaleWorks
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Liam Price <liam.price@scaleworks.com>
Cc: Marta Ochoa <marta@scaleworks.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scaling pathway: technical preview & topology deep-dive

Hi Liam — great to hear you're ready to move forward. Thanks for the discovery doc, that helps.

We can run a 75-minute session and include the following agenda:
1) 10m — introductions & goals alignment
2) 25m — runtime topology and batching/latency tradeoffs
3) 20m — KV cache behavior and warmup strategies (including sequence examples)
4) 15m — multi-region routing and failover strategy + Q&A
5) 5m — next steps / mutual action items

Suggested attendees from Redwood: me (pre-sales lead), Ben Carter (runtime engineer), Rishi Malhotra (solutions architect).

We have these confirmed windows (PT):
- Tue Jul 26: 10:00–11:15 (we have a small conflict at 09:00)
- Thu Jul 28: 09:30–10:45 (ideal for our engineers)

If Thu Jul 28 09:30 PT works, we'll lock that and circulate a calendar invite. Otherwise we can take Tue Jul 26 10:00. Please note we normally ask for a brief system diagram and current traffic profile (tokens/sec, typical request sizes) as pre-read so Ben can prep a short bench plan.

I've attached a one-pager agenda and a pre-read checklist. Also here's a link to a placeholder event we can replace with the final invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-invite-id

Attachments: redwood-deep-dive-agenda-v1.docx (1 page)

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
Office: +1 415-555-0148
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam Price <liam.price@scaleworks.com>, Marta Ochoa <marta@scaleworks.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scaling pathway: technical preview & topology deep-dive

Quick note from runtime side — Thu Jul 28 09:30 PT works for me. I'll plan to cover:
- how we size batch windows and the tradeoffs for latency vs token cost
- KV cache lifecycle and cache affinity when you have many short-lived sessions
- recommended topology for multi-region read-through with failover (we'll sketch a diagram)

Can you ask the ScaleWorks team to include:
- a simple system diagram (k8s cluster layout / ingress / current RTT to cloud regions)
- typical per-request token sizes and peak qps for a 5-minute window

I'll prepare a short bench plan (local-sim) and a quick diagram to share in the call.

Ben Carter
Runtime Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Liam Price <liam.price@scaleworks.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Ochoa <marta@scaleworks.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scaling pathway: technical preview & topology deep-dive

Thanks, Tessa and Ben — Thu Jul 28 09:30 PT is perfect. I've looped in our security lead (Marta) and she'll bring the system diagram and traffic sample ahead of the call.

I've accepted the placeholder calendar link and attached a brief note with the test workload we want to validate (token_size_samples.csv) — it's a small CSV extract. Also included in case you want to run any pre-checks: our cluster runs in GCP us-west1, ingress on GKE with Istio sidecars, GPU nodes are n1-standard-16 with NVIDIA A100 for current experiments.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-invite-id
Attachments: token_size_samples.csv (1 KB)

See you Thu Jul 28 09:30 PT — please send final invite when you lock it.

Liam
